summary.text: Phil Robinson has served in the Ohio House of Representatives since 2018 and represents House District 19 in northeast Ohio. He is the Assistant Minority Leader.

paragraphs.text: Born and raised in Northeast Ohio, Robinson graduated from Gilmour Academy and earned an undergraduate degree in finance from The George Washington University, then worked as a congressional legislative aide for U.S. Senator Dianne Feinstein.
He later earned an Executive MBA from the Case Western Reserve University Weatherhead School of Management.
Robinson was Executive Director of City Year Cleveland and later Senior Vice President for Regional and Site Operations for City Year, Inc.
Since being elected, he served three years as Chief Impact Officer for Reading Partners and is now Chief Executive Officer of the Forum for Youth Investment.
He and his wife, Elizabeth, live in Solon with their two children.
